verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations, triggers, schedules, or background workflows that AssemblyAI runs on its own. Asynchronous transcription and SDK polling are per-request job processing, not automations a user sets up. Integrations with agent frameworks such as Langflow are developer building blocks and host-platform capabilities, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
